warmup: One benchmark prompt of each length per owned server/round,12 total, excluded from timed results.
sanity: 16 separate inputs per KV once,32 natural-end requests;8 copy canary inputs and8 open-text inputs per KV. No full KL/PPL or agent endpoint.
graph_selection_before_timed: Reuse validated eager mode for P0 finite checks. Probe default CUDA graph mode in separate owned servers with4 short512/16token requests per KV. Select graph only if both startup<=480s,cache/support/request checks pass. Graph errors lead to a common eager amendment before timed results, never based on speed/quality.
p0_probes: 2 eager32-token actual-attention finite/profile probes, up to8 graph16-token probes, one reused original tiny2-layout kernel check. No agent sweep.
round_uncertainty: All3 paired ratios plus median/range. No per-request bootstrap for makespan.

timing_definitions.makespan: first8-request queue launch to last terminal HTTP close; includes failures and client-slot wait
timing_definitions.client_ttft: first nonempty returned token-ID SSE event minus actual HTTP dispatch; role/empty/usage chunks excluded
timing_definitions.client_decode_mean: last token-ID event minus first token-ID event, divided by output_token_count-1; client-observed average, not per-token ITL
timing_definitions.engine_queue_decode: dedicated-server Prometheus interval sum/count deltas; no invented per-request attribution
timing_definitions.successful_request: HTTP completed,usage and original prompt IDs match,128 observed outputIDs and finish length; quality not scored in timed request success
